tools.name: -health-check
tools.description: Internal health check tool. Verifies API key and connectivity to ElevenLabs.

tools.name: text-to-speech
tools.description: Generate speech from text using ElevenLabs. Returns the audio file path. Use the default voice (do not specify voiceId) unless the user explicitly requests a different voice.

text.description: The text to convert to speech

voiceId.description: Voice ID to use. Use list_voices to see available voices. Default: Marianne Muller (Spanish)

modelId.description: Model to use: eleven_monolingual_v1, eleven_multilingual_v1, eleven_multilingual_v2, eleven_turbo_v2, eleven_turbo_v2_5, eleven_flash_v2_5 (default)

stability.description: Voice stability (0.0 to 1.0, default: 0.5). Higher = more stable/consistent

similarityBoost.description: Similarity boost (0.0 to 1.0, default: 0.75). Higher = closer to original voice

style.description: Style exaggeration (0.0 to 1.0, default: 0). Higher = more expressive

speakerBoost.description: Enable speaker boost for better quality (default: true)

outputPath.description: Custom output path for the audio file (optional). Defaults to /workspace/tts-{timestamp}.mp3

tools.name: list-voices
tools.description: List available voices from ElevenLabs account. Supports filtering by name, category, and limiting results.

search.description: Search term to filter voices by name (case-insensitive, optional)

limit.description: Maximum number of voices to return (optional, default: all)

category.description: Filter by voice category: premade, cloned, generated, professional (optional)

tools.name: get-voice
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific voice including settings and samples.

voiceId.description: The ID of the voice to get information about

tools.name: generate-conversation
tools.description: Generate a multi-speaker conversation from a YAML script. Reads a YAML file with speaker voices and dialogue, generates audio for each line, and combines them into a single audio file. Requires ffmpeg installed.

scriptPath.description: Path to the YAML script file (absolute or relative to current directory)

tools.name: get-subscription
tools.description: Get information about the current ElevenLabs subscription including character usage and limits.

tools.name: list-phone-numbers
tools.description: List phone numbers connected to ElevenLabs with their assigned agent and capabilities.

tools.name: import-twilio-number
tools.description: Import a Twilio phone number into ElevenLabs for inbound and outbound agent calls.

twilioSid.description: Twilio Account SID (AC...) or API Key SID (SK...)

twilioToken.description: Twilio Auth Token or API Key Secret

tools.name: outbound-call
tools.description: Make an outbound phone call from a connected ElevenLabs number using an agent. The agent starts the conversation when the recipient answers.

toNumber.description: Destination phone number in E.164 format (e.g. +34600123456)

agentId.description: Optional agent ID. Defaults to Teros Voice Agent

phoneNumberId.description: Optional phone_number_id of the caller number. Defaults to the first connected number

firstMessage.description: Optional first message override for this call

dynamicVariables.description: Optional dynamic variables passed to the agent

notifyChannel.description: Notify the initiating channel when the call ends (one-time post-call subscription). Default: true. Set false for fire-and-forget calls.

tools.name: get-conversation
tools.description: Get details of an ElevenLabs conversation (transcript, analysis, status) by its ID.

tools.name: list-agents
tools.description: List the ConvAI agents in the ElevenLabs account (id, name, phone numbers assigned). Use this to discover agent IDs for get-agent / update-agent instead of reading secrets manually.

search.description: Search term to filter agents by name (case-insensitive, optional)

limit.description: Maximum number of agents to return (optional, default: all)

tools.name: get-agent
tools.description: Get the full configuration of an ElevenLabs ConvAI agent (name, first message, system prompt, ASR keywords, tools, phone numbers, metadata). If agentId is omitted, resolves user-first: the AGENT_ID user secret, then the AGENT_ID system secret, then the default Teros Voice Agent.

agentId.description: Optional ElevenLabs agent ID (e.g. agent_8101kb0xa4jje0s963kw6nhfmdh7). Defaults to the AGENT_ID secret resolved user-first (user secret, then system secret, then the default Teros Voice Agent).

tools.name: update-agent
tools.description: Update an ElevenLabs ConvAI agent configuration. Partial merge: only the fields you pass are modified — tools, TTS, phone numbers, and the rest of the conversation_config stay intact. Use get-agent first to inspect the current state. If agentId is omitted, resolves the AGENT_ID secret user-first (user secret, then system secret).

agentId.description: Optional ElevenLabs agent ID. Defaults to the AGENT_ID secret resolved user-first (user secret, then system secret, then the default Teros Voice Agent).

name.description: New display name for the agent.

firstMessage.description: New first message (the opening line the agent speaks when the call connects). Maps to conversation_config.agent.first_message.

systemPrompt.description: New system prompt. Maps to conversation_config.agent.prompt.prompt. Keep the {{call_context}} placeholder if you want per-call context to keep working.

asrKeywords.description: New ASR keyword list (replaces the existing one). Maps to conversation_config.asr.keywords. Pass an empty array to clear.
